standard_prerequisites: the term set of a countable language and its cardinality
core_obligations: Prove that every consistent set Gamma of first-order sentences has a model whose domain is finite or denumerable
proof_roadmap: By completeness, consistent Gamma is satisfied by the term model M delivered by the construction
The domain of that term model is no larger than the term set of the language L, which is at most denumerable; hence M has finite or denumerable domain
difficulty_reason: A short application of the completeness construction; the content is the cardinality bound of the term model.
